Create a new project in a workspace.

For organization workspaces, a team is required. Set color, due date, and
privacy settings as needed.

Related commands:
  project list
  project view
  section create

Output modes:
  human, json, plain, jq, template

Usage:
  asana project create <name> [flags]

Examples:
asana project create "My Project" -w "My Workspace"
asana project create "Q1 Goals" -w "Company" -t "Engineering" --color dark-blue
asana project create "Sprint 1" -w "Company" -t "Dev" --due-on 2024-12-31 --privacy private_to_team
asana project create "Test" -w "My Workspace" --dry-run
asana project create "New Sprint" -w "My Workspace"
asana section create "To Do" --project-gid <new-gid>
asana section create "In Progress" --project-gid <new-gid>
asana section create "Done" --project-gid <new-gid>

Flags:
      --color string           Project color
      --due-on string          Project due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  -h, --help                   help for create
      --privacy string         Privacy setting: public_to_workspace, private_to_team, or private
  -t, --team string            Team name (required for organizations)
      --team-gid string        Team GID
  -w, --workspace string       Workspace name
      --workspace-gid string   Workspace GID

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap machine output as {data, meta} (commands that expose request metadata)
      --jq string         Transform stable JSON output with a jq expression (commands with machine output)
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --plain             Print unstyled, copy-safe text (commands with human output)
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Render stable JSON output through a Go text/template (commands with machine output)
